title: ora2pg-gap-report baseline snapshot
description: The shape of a file written by `ora2pg-gap-report ... --save PATH` and read back by `--baseline PATH`. See ora2pg_gap_report/baseline.py for the source of truth this schema describes.

schema_version.description: Must match baseline.SCHEMA_VERSION exactly -- load_baseline() rejects any other value rather than risk silently diffing against a baseline computed by an incompatible grouping formula.

group_key.description: sha1(detector + source_file + object_name + snippet), truncated to 12 hex chars. Identifies findings as 'the same kind of thing' across scans for --baseline diffing -- NOT unique per finding: multiple genuinely distinct findings (e.g. the same DBMS_LOB call on two different lines of one package) share a group_key on purpose. See baseline.py's module docstring for why diffing is count-based per group rather than trying to match individual records.
